modal.title: Personal Score
modal.heading: How is this personalised to me?
modal.paragraph1: AI reads this product's full ingredients and nutrition data alongside your health profile — allergies, intolerances, medical conditions, medications, diet type and health goals — and gives it a 0-100 suitability score specifically for you.
modal.paragraph2: These combine the AI's specific findings (e.g. an allergen you're sensitive to, or something that supports one of your goals) with a nutrient-by-nutrient comparison against your own daily reference amounts. Calorie and protein targets are calculated from your age, weight, height and activity level where you've provided them; sugar, salt, saturated fat and fibre use general adult guidelines. Only nutrients that stand out (clearly good or clearly high) are shown.
modal.differHeading: Why does it differ from the Product Score?
modal.paragraph3: The Product Score (shown above this card) is general nutritional quality — the same number every user sees for this product, based on Nutri-Score, additives and organic status. The Personal Score is what that product means for you specifically: it can be much lower than the general score (e.g. a "healthy" product that contains an allergen you must avoid) or similar to it, depending entirely on your own health profile.
modal.changeHeading: Why might the score change if I re-scan this?
modal.paragraph4: The Personal Score is generated fresh by AI each time — it isn't a fixed, cached number. Scanning the same product again can produce a slightly different score or wording, even though nothing about the product or your health profile changed.
modal.note: AI analysis — this is nutritional/ingredient-based guidance, not medical advice. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical decisions, and check physical packaging for allergen information.

welcome.title: Welcome to Shuddh Aahar
welcome.body: Your personal clinical nutrition intelligence. We cross-reference every product against your specific health profile — your allergies, conditions, medications and goals.
welcome.tip: Takes about 60 seconds to set up

profile.title: First: Build Your Health Profile
profile.body: Add your allergies, medical conditions (e.g. Type 2 Diabetes, Hypertension), medications and dietary preferences. You can also upload GP letters and our AI reads them automatically.

scan.title: Scan Any Product
scan.body: Tap the Scan button and point your camera at any barcode. We cover millions of supermarket products across every store we support. Results appear in under 2 seconds.
scan.tip: Home tab → big blue Scan button

aiScore.title: Your Personalised AI Score
aiScore.body: AI gives every product a 0–10 suitability score just for you. You'll see a plain-English verdict (Safe / Caution / Avoid), specific clinical warnings, and exactly why the product is or isn't suitable.
aiScore.tip: Based on YOUR profile, not generic ratings

comparePrices.title: Compare Supermarket Prices
comparePrices.body: See prices across supported local stores — all on one screen. Highlighted in green is the cheapest option. Tap any store to buy directly.
comparePrices.tip: Scroll down on any product report

alternatives.title: Healthier Alternatives
alternatives.body: If a product isn't right for you, scroll further to see alternatives AI has specifically ranked for your health needs. Every suggestion explains why it's better for you.
alternatives.tip: Appears below prices on unsuitable products

foodDiary.title: Food Diary & Daily Tracking
foodDiary.body: Log scanned products to your daily food diary. Track calories, macros (carbs, protein, fat, sugar, salt) against recommended targets. Your Apple Health or Google Fit step count adjusts your calorie goal.
foodDiary.tip: Diary tab → Log to Diary after any scan

wishlist.title: Price Tracker
wishlist.body: Tap "Add to Price Tracker" on any product that suits your health profile. Build a personalised list of recommendations with estimated total cost. Tick items off as you shop.
wishlist.tip: Price Tracker tab → shows all your saved safe products

allSet.title: You're All Set!
allSet.body: Shuddh Aahar works best when your health profile is complete. Start by scanning something in your kitchen — you might be surprised what the AI finds. Help is always one tap away.
allSet.tip: Profile → How Shuddh Aahar Works, any time

productScoreCard.blurbBad: Best kept as an occasional treat
productScoreCard.scoringIntro: Scoring is based on three criteria:
productScoreCard.nutritionalValueBody: Based on Nutri-Score, which measures the nutritional balance of a product using calories, sugar, salt, saturated fat, protein and fibre.
productScoreCard.additivesBody: Additives are substances added to a product to change its properties, such as preservatives, dyes or sweeteners. Each additive is assigned a risk level (safe / caution / avoid) based on published food safety guidance.
productScoreCard.organicStatusBody: Shuddh Aahar doesn't currently detect organic certification from our product data source, so this portion is held at a neutral value for every product rather than guessed.
productScoreCard.differsFromPersonalHeading: How this differs from the Personal Score
productScoreCard.differsFromPersonalBody: This Product Score is general nutritional quality — the same number every user sees for this product. The Personal Score (further down this screen) is tailored to you specifically: it uses AI to check this product against your own allergies, conditions, medications, diet and goals, so it can be quite different from this general score.
productScoreCard.modalNote: This score reflects general product quality — it is not personalised to your allergies, conditions or medications. Always check the physical label for allergen information.
